about: C4 (core/tools/tiers.mjs): the reviewed list of static helper functions whose pk-* creation does not count against an element. { element: [function names in its module] }. A listed function exists, creates a pk-*, is never called from the element lifecycle (connected, disconnected, changed, updated, render, template), and its module imports no other element statically. Every line here is a reviewed decision (#766); never add one to hide a finding.
